result.stdout:
dt-openapi: lint and compare OpenAPI documents against the Digitals rules.

Usage:
  dt-openapi lint <spec> [options]                  Fail when the document breaks a rule
  dt-openapi report <spec> [<out.html>]             Write an HTML report (default openapi-report.html)
  dt-openapi dashboard <spec>                       Browse the findings in the terminal
  dt-openapi swagger <spec> [<out.html>]            Write the contract as a Swagger UI page
  dt-openapi diff <design> <implementation>         Fail when the implementation differs from the design
  dt-openapi breaking <base> <revision> [options]   Fail on a breaking change between two versions
  dt-openapi changelog <base> <revision> [options]  List the changes between two versions
  dt-openapi ruleset [<out.yaml>] [--baseline]      Print or write the ruleset and its functions folder
  dt-openapi vacuum <args>                          Run the bundled vacuum
  dt-openapi oasdiff <args>                         Run the bundled oasdiff

<spec> is a path or URL to an OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 document, JSON or YAML.
lint, report, dashboard and ruleset take --baseline for the baseline ruleset: the industry
basics, without the Digitals house rules. Use it to audit an existing API. lint, report and
dashboard take --ruleset <file> to use another ruleset instead.
swagger writes one self-contained page, by default beside the spec with .html, that opens offline.
breaking wants a deprecated operation's x-sunset at least 180 days out.
Options after the arguments go to vacuum or oasdiff unchanged.

  vacuum lint <your-api-file.yaml> [flags]
  vacuum [command]

  apply-overlay       Apply an Overlay to an OpenAPI specification
  bundle              Bundle an OpenAPI specification with external references into a single document.
  completion          Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  dashboard           Show interactive console dashboard for linting report
  docs                Ship world-class, fast, modern and agent-ready OpenAPI and AsyncAPI docs with the printing press
  generate-ignorefile Generate an ignorefile from a lint report
  generate-ruleset    Generate a vacuum RuleSet
  help                Help about any command
  html-report         Generate an HTML report of a linting run
  language-server     Run a fully compliant LSP server for OpenAPI linting (Language Server Protocol)

result.stdout:
OpenAPI specification diff

Usage:
  oasdiff [command]

Compare two specs:
  breaking        Display breaking changes
  changelog       Display changelog
  diff            Generate a diff report
  summary         Generate a diff summary

Process a single spec:
  flatten         Merge allOf
  upgrade         Canonicalize an OpenAPI 3.x spec to the latest 3.x version
  validate        Validate an OpenAPI spec against the spec

Git integration:
  breaking-files  Display breaking changes in each spec against its own version in a git ref
  git-diff-driver Run as a git external diff driver to show OpenAPI changes inline in git log/diff

Reference:
  checks          Display checks
  schema          Display the JSON Schema of the JSON output

Additional Commands:
  completion      Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help            Help about any command

Flags:
      --config string   path to config file (overrides .oasdiff.* lookup; can also use the OASDIFF_CONFIG env var)
  -h, --help            help for oasdiff
  -v, --version         version for oasdiff

Use "oasdiff [command] --help" for more information about a command.

result.stdout:
Lint an OpenAPI, AsyncAPI or Arazzo specification, the output of the response will be in the terminal

Usage:
  vacuum lint <your-api-file.yaml> [flags]

Flags:
      --abs-paths                     If --details(-d) flag is active then output absolute paths
  -a, --all-results                   Render all results when using -d
  -c, --category string               Show a single category of results
  -d, --details                       Show full details of linting report
  -e, --errors                        Show errors only
  -n, --fail-severity string          Results of this level or above will trigger a failure exit code (error, warn, info, hint, none) (default "error")
      --fix                           Apply auto-fixes for rules that support it
      --fix-file string               Write fixes to specified file instead of overwriting original
      --github-annotations            Emit GitHub Actions file annotation lines; can be combined with --pipeline-output
      --globbed-files string          Glob pattern of files to lint
  -h, --help                          help for lint
      --ignore-array-circle-ref       Ignore circular array references
      --ignore-file string            Path to ignore file
      --ignore-polymorph-circle-ref   Ignore circular polymorphic references
      --min-score int                 Throw an error return code if the score is below this value (default 10)
  -b, --no-banner                     Disable the banner output
      --no-clip                       Do not truncate messages or paths
  -m, --no-message                    Hide message output when using -d
  -q, --no-style                      Disable styling and color output
      --pipeline-output               Renders CI/CD summary output, suitable for pipelines
      --show-rules                    Show which rules are being used when linting
  -x, --silent                        Show nothing except the result
  -s, --snippets                      Show code snippets where issues are found

Global Flags:
      --all
[truncated]
